```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path

from itables import show
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import ticker
import numpy as np
import polars as pl

RESULTS_PATH = Path("../out")
COLOR = "darkslategrey"

langs = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "languages.parquet")
w = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "words.parquet")
s = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "syllables.parquet")
sf = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "syllables_freq.parquet")
f = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "frequencies.parquet")
p_ssp = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "posterior_ssp.parquet")
p_freq = pl.read_parquet(RESULTS_PATH / "posterior_freq.parquet")

cols = set(langs.columns).intersection(w.columns)
w = w.join(langs, on=list(cols)).with_columns(pl.col("word").str.len_chars().alias("n_char"))
s = s.join(langs, on=list(cols)).with_columns(n_phon = pl.col("syll").str.len_chars())
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-available-languages
data = (
    langs.with_columns(
        status=pl.when(pl.col("iso639p3code").is_in(w["iso639p3code"].to_list()))
        .then(pl.lit("Available"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("Not available"))
    )
    .group_by("status")
    .len("n")
)

values = data["n"]
labels = [f"{s}\n({n:,}, {n / sum(values):.2%})" for s, n in data.iter_rows()]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1)
p = ax.pie(
    values,
    labels=labels,
    radius=1,
    wedgeprops=dict(width=0.5, edgecolor="w"),
    colors=[COLOR, "lightgrey"],
)
```


### Column

```{python}
#| label: fig-language-families
cols = ["iso639p3code", "family_id"]
data = [
    langs.select(cols).with_columns(source=pl.repeat("Glottolog", len(langs))),
    w.select(cols)
    .unique("iso639p3code")
    .with_columns(source=pl.repeat("Selected", pl.len())),
]
data = (
    pl.concat(data)
    .group_by(["source", "family_id"])
    .len("n")
    .with_columns(
        rank=pl.col("n")
        .over("source")
        .rank("ordinal", descending=True)
        .cast(pl.Float64)
        / pl.len()
    )
    .sort("rank")
    .pivot(index="family_id", on="source", values="rank")
    .rename(lambda x: x.lower())
    .fill_null(0)
    .with_columns((pl.col("glottolog") - pl.col("selected")).alias("diff"))
    .with_columns(
        diff=(pl.col("diff") - pl.col("diff").min())
        / (pl.col("diff").max() - pl.col("diff").min())
    )
    .sort("diff", descending=True)
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1)
for f, g, si, d in data.iter_rows(named=False):
    ax.plot(
        ["Glottolog", "Selected"],
        [g, si],
        c="lightgrey" if si == 0 else COLOR,
        alpha=0.2 if si == 0 else 1,
    )
    if si != 0:
        _ = ax.text(1.07, si, f, ha="left", fontsize=6, alpha=0.75, color=COLOR)
_ = ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
_ = ax.text(x=-0.15, y=0, s="Least languages", rotation=90, va="bottom")
_ = ax.text(x=-0.15, y=1, s="Most languages", rotation=90, va="top")

```


# Words {scrollable=true}

## Column

```{python}
data = (
    w.group_by("iso639p3code")
    .len("n")
    .with_columns(
        qtile=pl.col("n").qcut(
            [0.25, 0.50, 0.75], labels=["1-25%", "26-50%", "51-75%", "76-100%"]
        )
    )
).sort("qtile", descending=True)

n_qtiles = len(data.unique("qtile"))
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, n_qtiles, figsize=(10, 7))

for i, d in enumerate(data.partition_by("qtile")):
    lang, n, q = d.sort("n").iter_columns()
    ax = axes[i]
    _ = ax.barh(lang, n, color=COLOR)
    _ = ax.set_title(f"Percentile {q[0]}", fontsize=10)
    
    _ = ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=6.5)
    _ = ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f"{int(x):5,d}"))
    _ = ax.axvline(100, linestyle="dotted", color="orange")
_ = fig.suptitle(f"Showing {len(data)} languages")
fig.tight_layout()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-word-lengths
v = {"char": "Characters", "phon": "Phonemes", "syll": "Syllables"}

for i, (var, label) in enumerate(v.items()):
    x=w[f"n_{var}"]
    ax = axes[i]

fig.tight_layout()
```

### Column

```{python}
#| label: fig-length-n
data = (
    w
    .group_by(["iso639p3code"])
    .agg(
        mean_phonemes=pl.col("n_phon").mean(),
        std_phonemes=pl.col("n_phon").std(),
        mean_characters=pl.col("n_char").mean(),
        std_characters=pl.col("n_char").std(),
        mean_syllables=pl.col("n_syll").mean(),
        std_syllables=pl.col("n_syll").std(),
        n=pl.len().log(),
    )
)

units = ["characters", "phonemes", "syllables"]
fig, (axes) = plt.subplots(1, len(units), figsize=(12, 5))

for i, var in enumerate(units):
    x = data["n"]
    coef = np.polyfit(x.to_list(), data[f"mean_{var}"].to_list(), 1)
    fit = np.poly1d(coef)
    ax = axes[i]
    _=ax.errorbar(
        x,
        data[f"mean_{var}"],
        yerr=data[f"std_{var}"],
        c="lightgrey",
        alpha=1 / 4,
        linestyle="None",
    )
    _=ax.plot(x, fit(x), lw=3, c=COLOR)
    _=ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f"{int(x):5,d}"))
    ax.scatter(x, data[f"mean_{var}"], s=10, c=COLOR)
    _=ax.set_title(f"{var.title()}")
    _, ymax = ax.get_ylim()
    _=ax.scatter(data["n"], [ymax + (ymax*0.05)] * len(data), marker="|", c="slategrey", alpha= 0.5)

    _, xmax = ax.get_xlim()
    _=ax.scatter([xmax + (xmax * 0.05)]*len(data), data[f"mean_{var}"],  marker="_", c="slategrey", alpha = 0.1)
_=fig.supxlabel("Log(number of words)")
fig.tight_layout()
```

# Lexical frequencies

## Row

### Column

```{python}
#| label: fig-freq-available
data = (
    w.select(["iso639p3code", "freq"])
    .group_by("iso639p3code")
    .agg(pl.col("freq").is_null().sum().alias("n_missing"), n=pl.len())
    .with_columns(prop_missing=pl.col("n_missing") / pl.col("n")).sort("prop_missing", descending=True)
    .with_columns(availability =pl.when(pl.col("prop_missing")==1).then(pl.lit("No frequecies available")).otherwise(pl.lit("Some frequencies available")))
    .group_by("availability")
    .len("n")
)

values = data["n"]
labels = [f"{s}\n({n:,}, {n / sum(values):.2%})" for s, n in data.iter_rows()]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1)
p = ax.pie(
    values,
    labels=labels,
    radius=1,
    wedgeprops=dict(width=0.5, edgecolor="w"),
    colors=["lightgrey", COLOR],
)
```

### Column

#### Row

```{python}
#| label: fig-freq-n
data = (
    w.select(["iso639p3code", "freq"])
    .group_by("iso639p3code")
    .agg(pl.col("freq").is_not_null().sum().alias("n_obs"), n=pl.len())
    .with_columns(prop_obs=pl.col("n_obs") / pl.col("n"), n=pl.col("n").log())
    .sort("prop_obs", descending=True)
    .filter(pl.col("prop_obs") != 0)
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1)
ax.scatter(data["n"], data["prop_obs"], c="lightgrey")
coef = np.polyfit(data["n"].to_list(), data["prop_obs"].to_list(), 1)
fit = np.poly1d(coef)
ax.plot(data["n"], fit(data["n"]), lw=3, c=COLOR)
_ = ax.set_ylabel("Observed lexical frequencies")
ax.set_label("Log(Number of words)")
_ = ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f"{x:.0%}"))

_, ymax = ax.get_ylim()
ax.scatter(
    data["n"], [ymax + (ymax * 0.1)] * len(data), marker="|", c="slategrey", alpha=0.5
)

_, xmax = ax.get_xlim()
ax.scatter(
    [xmax + (xmax * 0.1)] * len(data),
    data["prop_obs"],
    marker="_",
    c="slategrey",
    alpha=0.5,
)
```


```{python}
data = (
    s.group_by("struct")
    .len("n")
    .sort("n")
    .with_columns(
        struct=pl.when(pl.col("n") < (0.01 * len(s)))
        .then(pl.lit("Other"))
        .otherwise("struct"),
    )
    .group_by("struct")
    .agg(n=pl.col("n").sum())
    .sort("n")
    .with_columns(
        prop=pl.col("n") / pl.col("n").sum(),
        order=pl.when(pl.col("struct") == "Other").then(1).otherwise(0),
    )
    .sort(["order", "prop"], descending=[True, False])
)


fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(5, 5))
ax.barh(data["struct"], data["n"], color=COLOR, edgecolor="white", linewidth=3)
_ = ax.set_title("C = Consonant | V = Vowel | v = Semivowel")
_ = ax.set_xlabel("Number of distinct syllabic structures")
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f"{int(x):5,d}"))

ticks = ax.get_yticks()
labels = [f"{n:.3%}" for n in data["prop"]]
ax2 = ax.secondary_yaxis("right")
_ = ax2.set_yticks(ticks)
_ = ax2.set_yticklabels(labels, ha="left")
_ = ax2.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=7)

fig.tight_layout()
```

```{python}
    (
        s.group_by("iso639p3code")
        .agg(pl.col("is_ssp").mean(), n=pl.len())
        .sort("is_ssp", descending=False)
        .with_columns(is_ssp=pl.when(pl.col("is_ssp") == 1).then(1).otherwise(0))
    )

p = ax.pie(
```

## Row

### Column

```{python}
data = (
    s.group_by("iso639p3code")
    .agg(pl.col("is_ssp").mean(), n=pl.len())
    .filter(pl.col("is_ssp") != 1)
    .with_columns(se=((pl.col("is_ssp") * (1 - pl.col("is_ssp"))) / pl.col("n")).sqrt())
    .with_columns(
        qtile=pl.col("is_ssp").qcut([0.5], labels=["Bottom half", "Top half"])
    )
    .sort(["qtile", "is_ssp"], descending=[False, True])
    .partition_by("qtile", as_dict=True)
)


fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(data), figsize=(7, 5))
for i, (k, d) in enumerate(data.items()):
    ax = axes[i]
    dist_to_limit = d["is_ssp"] - 1
    yerr_clipped = np.maximum(d["se"], dist_to_limit)

    _ = ax.errorbar(
        d["is_ssp"],
        d["iso639p3code"],
        xerr=yerr_clipped,
        c=COLOR,
        alpha=1 / 4,
        linestyle="None",
    )
    _ = ax.scatter(d["is_ssp"], d["iso639p3code"], c=COLOR, s=7)

    _ = ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=6.5)
    _ = ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f"{x:.0%}"))
    ax.xaxis.grid(True, color="lightgrey", linestyle=":")

    ticks = ax.get_yticks()
    labels = [f"{p:.1%} ($N={n:5,d}$)" for p, n in zip(d["is_ssp"], d["n"])]
    ax2 = ax.secondary_yaxis("right")
    _ = ax2.set_yticks(ticks)
    _ = ax2.set_yticklabels(labels, ha="left")
    _ = ax2.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=5)

_ = fig.suptitle("Showing SSP-following < 100% languages only")
_ = fig.supxlabel("Proportion of SSP-following syllables")
fig.tight_layout()
```
